response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM film_copies GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM film_copies) SELECT fc.film_id, fc.rating, fc.copies, fc.copies - ra.avg_copies AS difference_from_rating_average, fc.copies - oa.avg_copies AS difference_from_overall_average FROM film_copies AS fc JOIN rating_averages AS ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films with no inventory count as having zero copies in both averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate both averages using only films that have at least one inventory copy.
